These findings collectively imply that L-methioninate may influence the Dr hemagglutinin structural subunit through a series of molecular pathways involving splicing factors and other regulatory proteins. The evidence is consistent across different pathways, suggesting a possible role for L-methioninate in modulating the Dr hemagglutinin structural subunit through target-mediated interactions.
